name: IIT Delhi
summary: IIT Delhi was established in 1961 as the College of Engineering and was declared an Institution of National Importance in 1963. Its 320-acre campus is in Hauz Khas, New Delhi, and B.Tech admission is through JEE Advanced and JoSAA.

totalStudents.notes: Total enrolment not found on a checkable source; the institute states it admits about 850 B.Tech and 1,400 postgraduate students a year.

applicationPlatform.value: JoSAA counselling after JEE Main and JEE Advanced
applicationPlatform.notes: Quoted by an official-domain search result; the page itself could not be fetched directly from the sandbox.

applicationFee.notes: JoSAA / JEE Advanced fees not verified.

testing.notes: Foreign nationals may register for JEE Advanced directly without JEE Main; supernumerary seats capped at 10% of seats per course.

internationalTuition.notes: IIT Delhi publishes foreign-national tuition in USD per semester (USD 1,000 SAARC / USD 2,000 non-SAARC plus INR 31,000 other charges, per a search result quoting the 2026-27 fee structure); not convertible into the INR field without guessing an exchange rate.

domesticTuition.notes: Tuition INR 1,00,000 per semester for General/OBC-NCL/EWS with family income above INR 5 lakh; INR 33,333 per semester for income INR 1-5 lakh; nil for income below INR 1 lakh and for SC/ST/PwD. Other charges are extra. 2025-26 entry structure; 2026-27 document not read.

scholarships.name: Merit-cum-Means (MCM) Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Awarded to 25% of admitted/sanctioned strength from General, OBC and EWS categories with parental income from all sources not exceeding INR 8 lakh per annum.
scholarships.coverage: INR 4,000 per month plus exemption from tuition fee

scholarships.name: Free Studentship
scholarships.eligibility: Based on financial need for up to 10% of students when MCM slots are full.

opportunities.name: FITT start-up incubation
opportunities.description: The Foundation for Innovation and Technology Transfer has run start-up incubation at IIT Delhi since 1999-2000 and reports 150+ start-ups incubated.

opportunities.name: Research and Innovation Park
opportunities.description: IIT Delhi's Research and Innovation Park hosts scale-up facilities with space for more than 125 start-ups.

opportunities.name: Startup@IITD
opportunities.description: Institute page listing start-ups and start-up programmes associated with IIT Delhi.

housing.value: Hostels on the main campus are self-contained, each with a reading room, indoor games room, lounge and a dining hall with mess; the international admissions site lists eleven boys' hostels and two girls' hostels.
housing.notes: As described on IIT Delhi's international admissions site; hostel numbers change as new hostels open.

admissionProcess.detail: Qualify in JEE (Main) to become eligible for JEE (Advanced). Foreign nationals have a separate route.
Obtain a rank in JEE (Advanced) and meet the Class XII performance criterion.
Register on JoSAA, lock branch choices, and accept a seat through the counselling rounds.
